<div class="project-stack">
  <a class="project-row-card" href="https://github.com/AmanPandey28/torch-compile-internals" target="_blank" rel="noopener">
    <span class="project-row-title">PyTorch Compiler &amp; LLM Inference Performance Analysis</span>
    <span class="project-row-meta">Correctness-gated torch.compile suite on RTX 5050 with FX capture, isolated caches, and fresh-process profiling. Replaced tensor-dependent control flow with torch.cond to reduce three FX regions to one full graph. Measured 2.07–2.12× FP32 pointwise speedup and 13.1–16.2% higher latency in a compiled 4.7M-parameter MLP.</span>
  </a>

  <a class="project-row-card" href="https://github.com/AmanPandey28/lpcv2026" target="_blank" rel="noopener">
    <span class="project-row-title">PyTorch → ONNX → QNN</span>
    <span class="project-row-meta">Static ONNX opset-16 export for MobileCLIP2-S2, FastViT reparameterization, and normalization/SDPA/EOS rewrites for Qualcomm QNN deployment. Validated 56 image and 211 text device outputs with unchanged R@10 of 0.897470.</span>
  </a>
